text: Setting clear project goals is the first step toward success. A useful approach is to create SMART goals, which are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. For example, instead of saying “improve the website,” a SMART goal would be “increase user engagement by 20% within three months.” Once goals are set, you should break them into smaller milestones, such as completing a design review or testing a prototype. These milestones help you track progress and deliverable final products on schedule. Equally important is stakeholder alignment—making sure everyone involved agrees on the objectives and expectations. Regular communication with stakeholders prevents misunderstandings and keeps the project moving in the right direction.
